en.headline: Kwong Hong-kit tells court he planned to blame father in Abby Choi case
en.dek: The defendant said he later abandoned the idea after lawyers urged him to tell the truth and wrote to his brother that lies would not work.
body: Kwong Hong-kit, one of three men charged with murdering model Abby Choi, told the High Court on Monday that he had once planned with his younger brother to shift blame for the killing onto their father. Under cross-examination on the 38th day of the trial, he said the idea was foolish and that he had thought it would cause the least harm to the family.

Kwong said he wrote to his brother while on remand, inventing a version of events in which their father killed Choi. He later abandoned that account after his legal team pressed him to tell the truth, describing the change as being “woken up” by his lawyers. About three weeks ago he wrote again to his brother, saying he would accuse the brother of the killing and urging him to speak the truth because lies would not work.

The three defendants — Kwong Hong-kit, his father Kwong Kau and his brother Kwong Hong-chi — deny murdering Choi in February 2023 and preventing the lawful burial of her body. They have admitted the lesser charge of preventing lawful burial. The trial before temporary judge Brian Keith continues.

zh.headline: 鄺港傑庭上稱曾計劃將蔡天鳳案責任推給父親
zh.dek: 被告指其後因律師要求說出真相而放棄，並寫信給弟弟稱說謊行不通。
body: 被控謀殺名媛蔡天鳳的鄺港傑，周一在高等法院表示，他曾與弟弟商量將殺人責任推卸給父親。案件踏入第38日審訊，他在控方盤問下說，當時想法愚蠢，以為這樣對家庭損失最少。
鄺港傑指，他在還押期間寫信給弟弟，虛構父親殺害蔡天鳳的版本。其後律師團隊要求他講出真相，他形容被「鬧醒」，遂放棄該說法。約三周前他再去信弟弟，表明會在庭上指控弟弟殺人，並勸對方講真相，因為說謊行不通。
三名被告分別為鄺港傑、其父鄺球及弟弟鄺港智，他們否認2023年2月謀殺蔡天鳳及阻止合法埋葬屍體，但承認較輕的阻止合法埋葬罪。案件由暫委法官祁彥輝審理，審訊繼續。
